dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Hi. I'm sorry to bother you, but there seems to be a problem with the air conditioning.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ. aɪm ˈsɑːri tə ˈbɑːðər juː, bʌt ðɛr ˈsiːmz tə bi ə ˈprɑːbləm wɪð ði ˈɛr kənˌdɪʃənɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Oh, I'm sorry. What's wrong with it?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, aɪm ˈsɑːri. ˈwʌts ˈrɔːŋ wɪð ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It isn't cold, and there's water on the floor. I think it has a leak.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈɪzənt ˈkoʊld, ənd ðɛrz ˈwɔːtər ɑːn ðə ˈflɔːr. aɪ ˈθɪŋk ɪt ˈhæz ə ˈliːk.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'm very sorry. I'll send someone to fix it now.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈvɛri ˈsɑːri. aɪl ˈsɛnd ˈsʌmwʌn tə ˈfɪks ɪt ˈnaʊ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you. There's also a bad smell in the bathroom.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː. ðɛrz ˈɔːlsoʊ ə ˈbæd ˈsmɛl ɪn ðə ˈbæθruːm.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'm sorry about that. We'll check it, too.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈsɑːri əˈbaʊt ðæt. wiːl ˈtʃɛk ɪt, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And I'm sorry to bother you again, but the elevator on our floor is out of order.
dialogue.reading: ənd aɪm ˈsɑːri tə ˈbɑːðər juː əˈɡɛn, bʌt ði ˈɛləveɪtər ɑːn aʊr ˈflɔːr ɪz ˈaʊt əv ˈɔːrdər.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, we know. Someone is fixing it now. Would you like a different room?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, wiː ˈnoʊ. ˈsʌmwʌn ɪz ˈfɪksɪŋ ɪt ˈnaʊ. wʊd juː ˈlaɪk ə ˈdɪfərənt ˈruːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, please. That would be great.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈpliːz. ðæt wʊd bi ˈɡreɪt.
